content: It is worth noting that the time complexity of beam search is INLINEFORM0 , where INLINEFORM1 is the beam width, and INLINEFORM2 is the maximum length of generated sequences. Therefore the exhaustive decoding is generally very computationally expensive, especially for One2Seq setting where INLINEFORM3 is much larger than in One2One. It is also wasteful as we observe that less than 5% of phrases generated by One2Seq models are unique.
